function attributeCountSetup(count) {
 const parent=document.createElement('div');
 parent.innerHTML='<i '+Array.from({length:count},(_,i)=>'a'+i+'="'+i+'"').join(' ')+'></i>';
 return parent.firstChild;
}
function attributeCountCase(variant) {
 const count=256+variant,d=attributeCountSetup(count),map=d.attributes,checks={};
 checks.count=map.length===count && d.attributes===map;
 const first=d.getAttributeNode('a0');
 checks.identity=map.length===count && map.item(0)===first && map.getNamedItem('a0')===first;
 d.removeAttributeNode(first);
 checks.removal=map.length===count-1 && first.ownerElement===null && first.value==='0';
 d.setAttributeNode(first);d.setAttribute('new','x');
 checks.attachment=map.length===count+1 && first.ownerElement===d && map.getNamedItem('a0')===first;
 d.setAttribute('new','y');
 checks.replacement=map.length===count+1 && d.getAttribute('new')==='y';
 let rejected=false;try{Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(NamedNodeMap.prototype,'length').get.call({});}catch(e){rejected=e instanceof TypeError;}
 checks.receiver=rejected;
 return checks;
}
